note.after_visit_summary: Thank you for coming in today. Here is what we talked about. Well, let's dry you off with some good news, hopefully. So here's the plan. I'd like you to cut back the caffeine gradually over the next 2 weeks, so you don't get withdrawal headaches. If the palpitations are still happening in 6 weeks after you've cut back, we will put a 2 week patch monitor on you to record your rhythm. If you ever faint, or have chest pain with the fluttering, or a racing heartbeat that won't stop, go to the emergency room. Otherwise I'll see you back in 6 weeks.
